description: Run an AI pipeline by slug with the given input. Use list_pipelines to discover available pipelines, get_pipeline_schema to see required inputs and estimate_pipeline_cost to check the price. Returns a run ID; use wait_for_pipeline_run to get the result. A run's output assets can be passed by ID as inputs to another pipeline.

input.description: Pipeline input fields as a JSON object. Use get_pipeline_schema to see required fields for each pipeline.

pipeline_slug.description: The slug identifier of the pipeline to run (e.g., 'image-generator', 'video-generator')

name: run_pipeline
